## Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
jcr_weather <- read_csv("data/JCR/Jalama Canyon Ranch Weather Station Data_10022024.csv")

# check col types
sapply(jcr_weather, class)
```

```{r}
p_jcr_precip <- jcr_weather |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(dayRain_c, monthRain_c, yearRain_c),
    names_to = "type",
    values_to = "rain_c"
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    type = case_when(type == "dayRain_c" ~ "Daily Precipitation",
                     type == "monthRain_c" ~ "Monthly Precipitation",
                     type == "yearRain_c" ~ "Annual Precipitation"),
    type = factor(type, levels = c("Daily Precipitation", "Monthly Precipitation", "Annual Precipitation"))
  ) |> 
  
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = utcdatetime,
      y = rain_c,
      color = type
    )
  ) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  scale_x_datetime(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%Y %b") +
  labs(
    x = "Date",
    y = "Precipitation (inches)",
    color = ""
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

p_jcr_precip

```

```{r}
jcr_weather |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(dayRain_c, monthRain_c, yearRain_c),
    names_to = "type",
    values_to = "rain_c"
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    type = case_when(type == "dayRain_c" ~ "Daily Precipitation",
                     type == "monthRain_c" ~ "Monthly Precipitation",
                     type == "yearRain_c" ~ "Annual Precipitation"),
    type = factor(type, levels = c("Daily Precipitation", "Monthly Precipitation", "Annual Precipitation"))
  ) |> 
  filter(type == "Daily Precipitation") |> 
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = utcdatetime,
      y = rain_c,
      color = type
    )
  ) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  scale_x_datetime(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%Y %b") +
  labs(
    x = "Date",
    y = "Precipitation (inches)",
    color = ""
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
```

```{r}
jcr_weather |> 
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = utcdatetime,
      y = temp
    )
  ) +
  geom_line() +
  tidyquant::geom_ma(ma_fun = SMA, n = 365, linetype = "solid", color = "red") +
  scale_x_datetime(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%Y %b") +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "Temperature (F)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
```
